archetypes.name: dyn-summary-contract
archetypes.rationale: Final-summary emit behavior is prompt-level and easy to alter by wording drift.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the shared final-summary emit contract and each /design call-site pointer. Confirm marker-first and file-only profiles preserve the prior source, fallback, sidecar, ordering, and no-paraphrase behavior. Pay special attention to Step 0b cancel routes, Step 5c abort handling, and Step 5d footer ordering. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
